title: Sunday · bad color · the dock
venue: Arthur's site (newspaper cadence: six dailies + a Sunday)
logline: The fourth Sunday the book keeps of the bad spring: the dock, the water bleeding into the planks, the shack's roof one wrong red. The reader can watch the paper buckle.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the dock from the water, the paint pooling, the planks and the bay the same wet gray because he couldn't wait for one to dry.

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, a wooden dock and bay water bleeding into each other in the same wet gray, the paper visibly buckled, no words

panels.name: Bleed

panels.composition: Tier 2: the shack's roof, a red that is not the roof's red — the set's only red, used because it's the only red.

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, a shingle shack roof painted in a single wrong bright red, no words

panels.name: Wrong red

panels.composition: Tier 3: the bay. Gray, and where the paper buckled, a ridge of darker gray across the water like a wave that isn't there. Held. He posts it.

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, gray bay water with a dark ridge of pooled paint across it where the paper buckled, no words

panels.name: Buckle

art.line: brush-pen scanned; muddy early-digital flats begin
art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in over-wet watercolor

notes: Bad color, the dock. The set's only red. Posted anyway.
